name: workers-council
description: Panel for the multi-LLM adversarial review council: assign members to layers, choose billing routes, and consult the panel. Shells out to consult_council.py; never handles API keys itself.

council.rootPath.description: Directory containing consult_council.py. When empty, each workspace folder is searched, then its council/ and Council/ subdirectories, then its parent directory.

council.pythonPath.description: Python interpreter used to run the council engine.
